name: Bharti Airtel

snapshot.about: Telecom services provider offering mobile, home broadband, enterprise solutions, digital services, and data center capabilities.

narrative: Management reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹60,900 crore, matching actual revenue of ₹60,878 crore. However, reported Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 57.0% differs from management's stated EBITDAaL margin of 51.7%.

promises.statement: Company plans to reach 1 gigawatt data center capacity in the next 3 to 4 years.

said.quote: Our plan is to reach 1 gigawatt capacity in the next three to four years and grow significantly ahead of the market

actual_source.quote: In addition, we invested about 2,900 Crores in a strategic land parcel to pursue our one-gigawatt data center capacity ambition

promises.note: Invested ₹2,900 crore in a land parcel in Q2 FY27 towards data center capacity goals.

promises.statement: Management expects FY2027 capex to be in the ballpark of FY2026 levels.

said.quote: So the net result of all of that, if you look at the capex, while we do not give guidance typically, our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit

actual_source.quote: Capex for the quarter was about Rs.13,390 Crores and the operational discipline continues to remain an enabler of our strong performance

promises.note: Capex totaled ₹13,390 crore in Q1 FY27 and ₹12,500 crore in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Management plans to build 56 edge data centers over the next 18 to 24 months.

said.quote: There is a big project that is underway, which we spoke about last time on resilience, just a resilience of our edge data centers and we are focused right now on building in the next 18 to 24 months- 56 world class edge data centers

promises.statement: Airtel expects to allocate significantly less than Rs. 14,000 Crores over five years for financial services.

said.quote: the total amount that we are looking at allocating in the next five years, we have stated Rs. 20,000 Crores, of which Rs.14,000 Crores has to come from Airtel. It looks like it will be probably significantly less than that

promises.statement: Airtel Money is preparing for a London listing in H2 FY27.

said.quote: Given this growth trajectory and the large addressable opportunity, Airtel Money is now preparing for a London listing in the second half of 2026

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹100,454 crore.
signals.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

cash.read: Profits turn strongly into cash, as operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore comfortably covered total reported net profit of ₹100,454 crore over FY22–FY26.

bull.point: Operating cash flow reached ₹419,802 crore over FY22–FY26, fully covering total reported net profit of ₹100,454 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹419,802 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹100,454 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Consolidated operating free cash flow reached ₹19,000 crore in Q2 FY27, backed by 4% sequential revenue growth to ₹60,900 crore.

evidence.quote: Consolidated revenue came in at about Rs.60,900 Crores, growing 4% sequentially
Capex for the quarter was about Rs.12,500 Crores, leading to a robust operating free cash flow, which is EBITDAaL minus capex, of over Rs.19,000 Crores

bull.point: Mobile ARPU expanded to ₹271 in Q2 FY27, while Africa constant currency revenue grew 6.7% sequentially.

evidence.quote: Africa delivered yet another solid performance with constant currency revenue growth of 6.7% sequentially
ARPU for the quarter came in at Rs.271, up from 264, benefited by one extra day in the quarter as well

bear.point: Disputed tax and regulatory dues total ₹47,044 million across various judicial forums, creating potential cash outflow liabilities.

evidence.quote: The Company has recognised provisions for probable outflows relating to regulatory matters, as applicable and have disclosed contingencies for regulatory matters where the obligations are considered possible

bear.point: Significant related-party transactions continue with subsidiary Indus Towers Limited for passive infrastructure services and energy cost reimbursements.

evidence.quote: Availing of service(s) including passive infrastructure services and/or related services required for active services viz. IBS, WiFi etc

bear.point: Capital expenditure remains high, with H1 FY27 capex reaching ₹25,890 crore plus an additional ₹2,900 crore land parcel investment in Q2 FY27.
